tools.name: search
tools.description: Search The Valley Desk directory of research software, publications and clinical studies connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley (Philadelphia region). Matches titles, topics, institutions and keywords. Every filter is optional. Returns up to 24 records per page with the site URL, the Verified

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get one publication, software project or clinical study by its directory id (from search or whats_new) or its thevalleydesk.org URL. Returns the regional connection and its source alongside kind-specific details.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: List records added to The Valley Desk directory on or after a date, newest additions first. The date is when the record entered the directory, which can differ from when the research was published.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List the regional institutions in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the institution filter in search.

tools.name: list_topics_and_counties
tools.description: List the topics and the nine Delaware Valley counties in The Valley Desk directory with the number of listings recorded for each. Use a returned name as the topic or county filter in search.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
